title: Abandoned Fair
content: So, last night I dreamt that I was at a fair/market at night. It really just seemed like a normal fair. I can only recal people in the little shops and booths that were there. The closer it got to morning the nicer these people became, giving me a ton of free stuff and trying to convince me to stay. It was almost morning and all of the shops became super bug infested and almost out of nowhere the fair looked like it had been abondoned for years. After that I was told that the fair had been abondoned for a while now and that I needed to leave because exploring it was unsafe. Has anyone else experienced something similar?
